name: state_passing
description: Mamba2 inter-chunk state-passing scan. states is [B, nchunks, nheads, dim], dA_cumsum is [B, nheads, nchunks, L] and only its last L element per chunk is used; initial_states is an optional [B, nheads, dim] tensor. With cur initialized from initial_states.float() (or zeros when None), for c = 0..nchunks-1: out[:,c] = cur cast to states.dtype; cur = cur * exp(dA_cumsum[b,h,c,-1]) + states[:,c]. Returns (out [B,nchunks,nheads,dim] in states.dtype, final_states [B,nheads,dim] float32) as new tensors; inputs are read only. Suites exercise bfloat16 states with and without initial_states and float32 dA_cumsum.
